subject: A red blindfold, four ready slogans
alt: Satish Acharya's cartoon: on a white ground lies a thick black hardback, tied with a red ribbon whose big bow sits on top. The cover reads SONIA GANDHI at the upper left and below it BELONGING: A JOURNEY OF LOVE, with a black-and-white portrait of Sonia Gandhi between them. Around the book stand four bald, pot-bellied, naked pink men, each blindfolded with a red cloth. The one on the left points a finger at the book and shouts: WHITEWASHING HISTORY! The one at the top throws his arms open and shouts: LIES! The one at the lower left spreads both hands and shouts: EXAGGERATED! And the one on the right raises a fist and shouts: ERRORS! The cartoonist's signature, SATISH ACHARYA, is at the lower right.
chutki: Sonia Gandhi's memoir 'Belonging: A Journey of Love' reached the market on 10 November - 544 pages, HarperCollins, ₹1,299. Acharya has set it down in the middle like a present tied with a red ribbon, and four voices stand around it: whitewashing, lies, exaggeration, errors.

The needle is in that red blindfold. None of the four holds the book; each holds only his own slogan, so the verdict was written before a single page was turned. For eyes that have chosen not to see, 544 pages mean nothing; the same chorus blocks the book from every side.
